## Quality checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the change against SOLID principles where applicable.
- [ ] I checked for retain cycles or memory leaks where applicable.
- [ ] I avoided force unwraps and force casts, or documented why they are safe.
- [ ] I preserved SwiftData compatibility or documented migration implications.
- [ ] I kept AppKit UI work on the main actor.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, or sensitive clipboard content.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and avoided unrelated formatting.
